lines.en: label yasuspecial20:
scene calmbeforethestorm1
I find myself in my office after what could only be referred to as...one of the most {i}interesting{/i} nights of my new life thus far.
lines.zh: 我不知怎么就到了自己的办公室——在经历过只能被称作……我这新人生迄今为止最「{i}有意思{/i}」的一夜之后。

lines.en: Not interesting in the way that involves dodging the end of the world with two of my niece’s closest friends, though.
lines.zh: 不过不是那种有意思：跟我[niece]两个最亲密的朋友一起躲过世界末日。

lines.en: Interesting in the fact that someone other than me was finally able to get Yumi to crumble, albeit in a much more...intentionally cynical and harmful way than my underlying compulsions of the past.
lines.zh: 有意思在于：除我之外终于有人能让 Yumi 崩溃了，尽管那方式比我过去那些潜藏的冲动要……刻意得多、愤世得多、也伤人得多。

lines.en: What that means for the future, I have no idea. Which is probably why I’ve taken it upon myself to seek shelter in here and let Imani handle homeroom for the day.
lines.zh: 那对将来意味着什么，我毫无头绪。大概正因如此，我才自作主张躲进这儿，让 Imani 去管今天的班会。

lines.en: Even if my current thoughts on Nodoka are a bit “off” compared to how they were last week, I still don’t think I want to watch her get murdered.
lines.zh: 就算我现在对 Nodoka 的看法比起上周有点「跑偏」，我依然不觉得自己想看她被谋杀。

lines.en: And I can’t say I want to see Yumi, a girl that I feel I’ve been genuinely helping in many ways lately, throw all of that away because I preemptively got to see her naked.
lines.zh: 我也不想看着 Yumi——一个我近来在很多方面真心帮到了的女孩——因为我不小心提前看了她的裸体，就把这一切全扔掉。

lines.en: if nodokaspecial15p3 == True:
Naked and...attempting to pleasure herself while I looked on and did nothing, sure.
lines.zh: 裸着……还试图在我看着、什么都不做的情况下取悦自己，没错。

lines.en: But, like Nodoka said back then...that was going to happen eventually, right?
lines.zh: 不过，就像 Nodoka 当时说的……那种事迟早会发生，对吧？

lines.en: I don’t know. Maybe I’m just grasping at straws in hopes of being able to pull myself out of the River Styx.
lines.zh: 我不知道。也许我只是在抓救命稻草，指望能把自己从冥河里拽出来。

lines.en: But seeing as I’m already on my way to Hades, I should probably just shut up and drown myself in its waters already.
lines.zh: 不过既然我已经在通往冥府的路上了，我大概该闭嘴，直接把自己溺死在那水里。

lines.en: Either way, the safest place for me right now is behind these doors.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，眼下对我来说最安全的地方就是这几扇门后面。

lines.en: For when I tear myself away from the harsh rays of the sun and slink back into the dark, I am somehow at my brightest and warmest.
lines.zh: 因为当我把自己从刺眼的阳光里撕下来、重新溜回黑暗中时，我不知怎么反倒处于最明亮、最温暖的状态。

lines.en: And there is nothing that can or {i}will{/i} take that away from me.
lines.zh: 而没有什么东西能够、或者{i}将会{/i}把那从我身上夺走。

lines.en: : Sensei, are you in there right now?
lines.zh: : 老师，你现在在里面吗？

lines.en: I think for a moment that remaining silent will create one more barrier between what goes on out there and me.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我觉得保持沉默能在外面发生的事和我之间再多砌一道墙。

lines.en: But as a master of second guessing myself, I tear the barrier down in hopes that someone else will build one in my stead.
lines.zh: 但作为一个自我怀疑的大师，我把这道墙拆了，指望别人能替我砌一道。

lines.en: And that the person at my door is only here to slink into the dark with me.
lines.zh: 也指望门外那个人只是来跟我一起溜进黑暗的。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I’m here.
lines.zh: : 我在。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm2
: Wonderful. Please do something about Yasu.
lines.zh: : 好极了。请处理一下 Yasu。

lines.en: : That’s a vague demand, but I think I get it.
lines.zh: : 这个要求很含糊，不过我想我懂。

lines.en: : You do? So you’ve already been informed that she refuses to set foot in the classroom today?
lines.zh: : 你懂？这么说你已经知道她今天拒绝踏进教室了？

lines.en: : I meant “get it” in the sense that there are many things that should probably be done regarding Yasu’s well being, but no. That is not something I was aware of.
lines.zh: : 我说的「懂」是指：关于 Yasu 的身心健康，大概有很多事该做。不过不，那件事我不知道。

lines.en: : Well, now that you have been made aware, I will take my leave and pawn the rest of this problem off on you.
lines.zh: : 那么，既然你已经知道了，我就告辞，把剩下的问题全推给你。

lines.en: : But dealing with Yasu is {i}your{/i} thing. The last time I tried to do anything for her, she...
lines.zh: : 可管 Yasu 是{i}你的{/i}事啊。上次我试着为她做点什么，她……

lines.en: : She what?
lines.zh: : 她什么？

lines.en: : I just realized I should probably keep that to myself.
lines.zh: : 我刚意识到那大概还是该留在我自己心里。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm3
: Sensei, I have already agreed to assist Ms. Watabe with cleaning up the archery range this morning and can not afford to be late to something I {i}personally{/i} assured her I would be on time for.
lines.zh: : 老师，我已经答应今早帮渡部老师打扫弓道场，不能对自己{i}亲口{/i}保证会准时到场的事迟到。

lines.en: : I may be Yasu’s current caretaker and...probably her legal guardian as well, but you are her teacher. Which means it is {i}your{/i} job to get her to go to class.
lines.zh: : 我也许是 Yasu 目前的看护人、大概还是她的法定监护人，可你是她的老师。也就是说，让她去上课是{i}你的{/i}工作。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But what if {i}I{/I} was also planning on not going to class today?
lines.zh: : 行，当然。可要是{i}我{/i}也打算今天不去上课呢？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm4
: Did you hear that, Yasu? You get to spend the whole day in this delightfully drab room with Sensei. Oh, how fun.
lines.zh: : Yasu，听到了吗？你可以整天跟老师待在这间愉快又乏味的屋子里。哦，多好玩。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm5
: Farewell! I have things to do and places to be!
lines.zh: : 再见！我有事要做、有地方要去！

lines.en: : And if she tells you she does not have lunch money, she is lying.
lines.zh: : 还有，要是她跟你说她没有午饭钱，她是在撒谎。

lines.en: : To lie would be one step short of a cardinal sin. I can not lie, for I have already incurred more of His wrath than I am able to handle.
lines.zh: : 撒谎离大罪只差一步。我不能撒谎，因为我已经招惹了超出我承受能力的祂的怒火。

lines.en: Welp, I guess this is a thing I am dealing with now.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来这就是我现在要对付的事了。

lines.en: Here’s hoping she doesn’t climb on top of anything and start speaking in tongues again.
lines.zh: 只希望她别爬到什么东西上头，又开始说方言。

lines.en: Though, I suppose if she’s going to have an orgasm anywhere in the school building, this is probably the safest room to do it.
lines.zh: 不过我想，如果她非要在学校楼里什么地方高潮一场，这大概是最安全的房间了。

lines.en: : So...what’s going on? Why aren’t you going to class?
lines.zh: : 那么……怎么回事？你为什么不去上课？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm6
: There are some doors that must remain closed. For the more people that set foot inside the areas they conceal, the closer those doors come to disappearing entirely.
lines.zh: : 有些门必须保持关闭。因为踏入它们遮住的区域的人越多，那些门就越接近彻底消失。

lines.en: : Can you say that again, but without the cryptic metaphor?
lines.zh: : 你能不能再说一遍，去掉那些玄乎的比喻？

lines.en: : Something bad is going to happen today.
lines.zh: : 今天会有坏事发生。

lines.en: : Something bad happens almost every day. But, based on what I experienced yesterday, you’re probably right.
lines.zh: : 几乎每天都有坏事发生。不过基于我昨天的经历，你大概是对的。

lines.en: How she can sense this beforehand is another question entirely, though.
lines.zh: 至于她怎么能在事前就感知到，那是另一个问题了。

lines.en: : This is different.
lines.zh: : 这次不一样。

lines.en: : This is not His word, but the word of the world itself.
lines.zh: : 这不是祂的话，而是这个世界本身的话。

lines.en: : It speaks through the wind, backwards and under the cover of the shadows. The same language the cicadas speak.
lines.zh: : 它借着风说话，倒着说，藏在影子的掩护下。跟蝉说的是同一种语言。

lines.en: : Right. And how long have you been able to speak to bugs?
lines.zh: : 行。那你跟虫子说话多久了？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm7
: Bugs are my friends.
lines.zh: : 虫子是我的朋友。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know what your friends told you, but premonitions aren’t really a viable excuse for not going to class.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道你那些朋友跟你说了什么，但预感可不是不去上课的正当理由。

lines.en: : Besides, if you try to live your entire life avoiding confrontation, what are you going to do when said confrontation becomes unavoidable?
lines.zh: : 再说，如果你一辈子都想着躲开冲突，那等那个冲突真的躲不掉了，你打算怎么办？

lines.en: : Face your fears now so they’ll be less scary later. Also, don’t you have, like...divine protection or whatever?
lines.zh: : 现在就面对恐惧，以后它们才没那么可怕。而且，你不是有……神的庇佑什么的吗？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm8
Yasu grows silent (Something I can rarely say when I am alone with her) and stares at the corner of the room.
lines.zh: Yasu 沉默了（这话在我跟她独处时很少能说），盯着房间角落。

lines.en: I imagine she’s mentally sorting through memorized religious texts pertaining to which sin “conflict” is and-
lines.zh: 我想她在心里默背着宗教经文，想搞清楚「冲突」属于哪一种罪——

lines.en: : I have not heard His voice since you last left my room.
lines.zh: : 自从你上次离开我的房间之后，我就再没听见祂的声音。

lines.en: : I believe He is angry with me. But I do not understand what it is I did that would have angered Him.
lines.zh: : 我相信祂在生我的气。但我不明白我到底做了什么会让祂生气。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm9
: That...That is why I can not go to class!
lines.zh: : 那……那就是我不能去上课的原因！

lines.en: : I will not know what the bad thing is until it happens! And if I am the one endangered and something bad happens to {i}me,{/i} what will become of Him when His voice returns?!
lines.zh: : 在那件坏事发生之前，我不会知道它是什么！而如果我是那个身处险境的人、坏事又偏偏发生在{i}我{/i}身上，那等祂的声音回来时，祂会变成什么样？！

lines.en: : It is my duty to protect the world! Mine alone! I can not do this if I am forced off of this plane before I am ready to leave!
lines.zh: : 保护这个世界是我的职责！是我一个人的！如果我还没准备好离开，就被迫从这个位面上被抹掉，我就做不到这件事了！

lines.en: : You really can’t think of anything you did that would have angered your god?
lines.zh: : 你真想不出有什么事会惹你的神生气？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm10
: All I remember about that night is the feeling of His warmth as it flooded my undeserving body. An outpouring of holy pleasure that I-
lines.zh: : 那天晚上我只记得祂的温暖灌进我不配拥有的身体时的感觉。一股神圣的愉悦倾泻而出，我——

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. Let’s just leave it at “an outpouring of holy pleasure” and not think any more about it.
lines.zh: : 好，行。我们就停在「一股神圣的愉悦倾泻而出」，别再往下想了。

lines.en: : That night aside, though, I can’t imagine there is anyone in class that wants to hurt you, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 不过除了那天晚上，我想象不出班上有谁会想伤害你，Yasu。

lines.en: : You may be weird, but I don’t think you have any enemies. So if anything bad {i}were{/i} to happen, which it probably will, I doubt you’d be directly involved.
lines.zh: : 你也许很怪，但我不觉得你有什么敌人。所以就算{i}真有{/i}坏事发生——大概率会有——我怀疑也不会直接牵扯到你。

lines.en: : I guess that {i}would{/i} call into question why the...wind and bugs informed you about it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我想那{i}也{/i}引出了一个问题：为什么那些……风和虫子会把这事告诉你。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm11
: The world did not speak to me directly- it was conversing with itself. Speaking alone for it has no one else to talk to.
lines.zh: : 世界不是直接对我说话——它在跟自己对话。自言自语，因为它没有别人可说。

lines.en: : How lonely it must be to be the last of your kind.
lines.zh: : 作为同类中的最后一个，该有多孤独啊。

lines.en: : I have felt the urge on many occasions to try and speak back to it, but I worry of what God would do to me if I shared my inner voice with anyone but Him.
lines.zh: : 我有过很多次冲动想试着回应它，可我担心如果我把内心的声音分享给祂以外的任何人，神会怎么对我。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and try to figure out how I am going to deal with an entire day's worth of this.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，试着想清楚我要怎么应付这一整天。

lines.en: It dawns on me after a moment or two of quiet contemplation that such a feat is impossible, and that this is probably why I have a student teacher in the first place.
lines.zh: 安静沉思了一两分钟之后，我明白过来：这种壮举是不可能的，而这大概正是我一开始就配了个实习老师的原因。

lines.en: If I can get Yasu back to class, I can pawn the responsibility off on her and then leave before anyone is killed and go back to spending my time alone.
lines.zh: 如果我能把 Yasu 弄回教室，就能把责任推给她，然后在任何人被杀之前开溜，继续一个人待着。

lines.en: It’s not the most responsible of strategies, but it’s the easiest and least likely to result in a bout of mental exhaustion that will put me out of commission for the entire weekend.
lines.zh: 这不是最负责的策略，但它最简单，也最不可能让我精神透支到整个周末都报废。

lines.en: : You have to go back to class, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 你得回去上课，Yasu。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm9
: But...the bad thing!
lines.zh: : 可是……那件坏事！

lines.en: : I’m sure that whatever “the bad thing” is will come to pass.
lines.zh: : 我确信不管「那件坏事」是什么，它都会发生。

lines.en: : At the very least, Imani and Makoto will be able to handle it a lot better than I can.
lines.zh: : 至少，Imani 和 Makoto 处理起来会比我强得多。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : No excuses. Go.
lines.zh: : 别找借口。去。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: : But I don’t know which way the classroom is!
lines.zh: : 可我不知道教室在哪个方向！

lines.en: : What? You’ve been here for months.
lines.zh: : 什么？你都在这儿好几个月了。

lines.en: : Touka always grabs my collar and pulls me to where I am supposed to be. Without her, I am nothing. A worthless, discarded husk of a human- stuck to the side of a fence and waiting for the wind to blow me away.
lines.zh: : 一直是 Touka 抓着我的衣领、把我拽到该去的地方。没有她，我什么都不是。一具一文不值、被丢弃的人类躯壳——黏在栅栏边上，等着风把我吹走。

lines.en: : Ugh...
: Fine. I’ll walk you back. But I’m not hanging around for long, got it?
lines.zh: : 行。我送你回去。但我不会待很久，明白吗？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm11
: Yes. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 好。谢谢。

lines.en: : I am sorry for filling your day with these wasted words of mine that do less for your mind than the act of watching paint dry.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我用这些废话填满了你的一天，它们对你们心智的作用，还不如看油漆干。

lines.en: : That sounds like something you’d be into, given your tendency to stare at walls and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 听上去像是你会喜欢的事，毕竟你有盯着墙什么的倾向。

lines.en: : I do not stare {i}at{/i} the walls. I stare {i}through{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}盯着{/i}墙看。我是{i}透过{/i}墙看。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. It’s time to leave.
lines.zh: : 好了。该走了。

lines.en: : Wait! My collar!
lines.zh: : 等等！我的衣领！

lines.en: : I’m not grabbing your collar, Yasu. It will make me look bad.
lines.zh: : 我不会抓你衣领的，Yasu。那会让我看起来很糟。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm12
: Is the world speaking to you again?
lines.zh: : 世界又在跟你说话了？

lines.en: : It speaks, but I can not discern the words.
lines.zh: : 它在说，但我听不清那些话。

lines.en: : Its tone is one of excitement...like it is anticipating what will soon befall us.
lines.zh: : 它的语气是兴奋的……像是在期待即将降临到我们头上的事。

lines.en: : But what reason would one have to look forward to something that both sounds and feels like a bed of heated nails?
lines.zh: : 可一个人有什么理由去期待一件听上去、摸上去都像一床烧红的钉子的事？

lines.en: : Some people just...like watching the world burn, I guess.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是……喜欢看世界烧起来吧，我想。

lines.en: : The world is not who will burn. It is all of us who live inside of it that will.
lines.zh: : 会烧起来的不是世界。是我们这些住在它里面的人。

lines.en: : Well, at least we get to die together. That’s a plus, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少我们能死在一起。那算个优点，对吧？

lines.en: : There is no death. Just-
lines.zh: : 没有死亡。只是——

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm13
: Oh, look. We’re here. And not a second too late.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。我们到了。而且来得正是时候。

lines.en: : It’s been fun. But I’ll see you later, Yasu. Tell Touka that the next time she wants me to do her dirty work, she should-
lines.zh: : 挺开心的。不过回头见，Yasu。告诉 Touka，下次她想让我干她的脏活，她应该——

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm14
: Wait. You have to come inside.
lines.zh: : 等等。你必须进来。

lines.en: : That was not the deal.
lines.zh: : 我们可不是这么说的。

lines.en: : The deal was that you will not hang around for long. You have not done any hanging at all.
lines.zh: : 我们说的是你不会待很久。而你根本一点都没待。

lines.en: : Does this not count as hanging?
lines.zh: : 这不算「待」吗？

lines.en: : I am not an expert, but I don’t think it does.
lines.zh: : 我不是专家，但我觉得不算。

lines.en: : Five minutes.
lines.zh: : 五分钟。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm15
: Yay! Praise be!
lines.zh: : 耶！赞美主！

lines.en: scene black
Well, somehow or another, it looks like I have failed the only goal I put in place for myself today.
lines.zh: 好吧，不知怎么的，看来我今天给自己定的唯一目标失败了。

lines.en: I slide the door open for Yasu in an attempt to let her in first. However, still being a little...uneasy about the fact that she’s about to come face to face with “the bad thing,” she clings to my arm for support.
lines.zh: 我拉开教室门，想让 Yasu 先进去。然而，由于她对「即将直面那件坏事」还是有点……不安，她抓住了我的胳膊寻求支撑。

lines.en: And while walking into the class with anyone {i}else{/i} around my arm would probably be cause for concern, I can’t imagine it will be much of a problem with Yasu.
lines.zh: 虽然换成{i}别人{/i}挽着我的胳膊走进教室大概会招来议论，但换成 Yasu 我想不会有什么问题。

lines.en: People will probably just see her without Touka and think that she needed some other body to absorb the life force of or something.
lines.zh: 人们大概只会看到她没跟 Touka 在一起，以为她需要另一具身体来吸收生命力什么的。

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm16
Strike that.
lines.zh: 收回前言。

lines.en: If even {i}Futaba{/i} is looking at us with an air of skepticism about her, I’m sure it’s only a matter of time until someone else points this out as well.
lines.zh: 如果连 {i}Futaba{/i} 都用那种怀疑的眼神看我们，我确信别人指出来也只是时间问题。

lines.en: : Umm...
: If it helps clear the air at all, I didn’t want this either.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让气氛缓和一点的话——我也不想这样。

lines.en: : Yasu is worried that something bad is going to happen today and...I guess she thinks I can protect her from that?
lines.zh: : Yasu 担心今天会有坏事发生，而且……我想她觉得我能保护她？

lines.en: scene calmbeforethestorm17
: Something bad? Like...what, exactly? It’s seemed like a mostly normal day so far.
lines.zh: : 坏事？比如……具体是什么？今天到目前为止看着挺正常的。

lines.en: : Something that will shake the foundation of all that we know to its very core...An undeniable, horrible turn of events that will flip the world on its head, pouring all of us into the abyss in the process.
lines.zh: : 一件会从根本上动摇我们所知一切的事……一场确凿无疑、可怕的转折，会把世界整个掀翻，顺带把我们都倒进深渊。

lines.en: : You should run while you still have the chance. You should wrap your arms around those you cherish and escape to an area outside the grasp of the sky’s mighty tendrils-
lines.zh: : 你们应该趁还有机会赶紧跑。你们应该抱住珍视的人，逃到天空那强有力的触手够不到的地方——

lines.en: : For the moment they begin to extend in your direction, it is already too late.
lines.zh: : 因为等它们开始朝你们伸过来的时候，就已经太迟了。

lines.en: : We are already doomed.
lines.zh: : 我们已经注定要完了。

lines.en: : So, yeah. This has been my morning so far.
lines.zh: : 所以，对。这就是我今天的上午。

lines.en: : I’m...beginning to understand why you left Miss- Uhh...Why you left Imani in charge of the class.
lines.zh: : 我……开始理解你为什么把今泉老师——呃……为什么把 Imani 留下管班了。

lines.en: : These...{i}tendrils{/i} that you speak of...
lines.zh: : 你说的这些……{i}触手{/i}……

lines.en: : Can you tell me more about them?
lines.zh: : 你能再多跟我说说它们吗？

$ yasuspecial20 = True
